system.description: This power allows you to look into the eyes of a corpse and view the last five minutes those eyes saw in life, often images of the target's killer and the manner of death. Insight also works on the walking dead, and may allow you to perceive the identity of a vampire's sire. A Mental Challenge must be won if the target resists. (This power is listed as an additional Basic-level Necromancy power in this supplement.)
